title: Rule pack allowlist
description: Supplemental external opengrep packs, enabled per rule. Permissive by design: each pack carries an enabled flag, a source pointer and per-rule / held_back lists whose shapes vary. The shipped default enables no supplemental pack. A Tier 2 setting: a scope-ref document imported whole with no assessment and versioned by traust-core's settings service (`traust settings`), so a change is a successor version with its `revision`, never an edit; readers take the latest.

revision.description: Who set this version and why. Written by traust-core's settings service from the verified caller (or the recording run) and its clock; a caller never supplies it.

set_by.description: The principal (<kind>:<identity>) or run that set this version.

reason.description: Why it changed, in the setter's words.
